definition_zh: 元认知；对自身思维过程的认识与调控
definition_en: knowledge and control of one's own thinking processes, such as noticing whether one has understood something
core_image: 一个人脑中亮起第二盏灯，照着自己正在思考的那盏灯
scene: 自习室里，一名学生读完一章统计教材，停下来问自己能否用自己的话复述公式。The tutor calls that moment of doubt healthy metacognition.
sceneCN: 这里 metacognition 指「对自己是否真正理解的觉察」（第 1 个义项：对自身思维过程的认识）；句意为导师把这种怀疑的瞬间称为健康的元认知。场景要素：摊开的统计书、写满批注的便签、停下的笔。

pos.zh: 元认知；对自身认知活动的认识与调节

derivatives.zh: 由 metacognition 加形容词后缀构成，指与元认知有关的
由 metacognitive 加副词后缀构成，指以元认知的方式
由拉丁语「认识」的名词直接进入英语，指认知活动本身，不含自我监控这一层
由 cognition 加形容词后缀构成，泛指与心理加工有关的
由表「再次」的前缀加「认识」词根构成，指把某物认作先前见过

senses.title: Awareness of one's own thinking
senses.definition: conscious knowledge that one is thinking, remembering or reasoning, and of what one is doing mentally
senses.definitionCN: 对自己正在思考、记忆或推理，以及正在做什么心理活动的自觉认识
senses.example: She caught herself rereading the same line and began to monitor her own comprehension.
senses.exampleCN: 她发现自己反复读同一行，于是开始监控自己的理解情况。
senses.why: The Greek prefix adds 'about itself' to the Latin noun for knowing, so the compound literally names knowing about knowing.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语前缀给拉丁语中表「认识」的名词加上「关于自身」，因此这个复合词字面上就是「对认识的认识」。

senses.title: Monitoring comprehension
senses.definition: checking, while reading or listening, whether one has actually understood the material
senses.definitionCN: 在阅读或听讲的过程中核查自己是否真的理解了材料
senses.example: He marked the paragraph he could not paraphrase and returned to it after class.
senses.exampleCN: 他标出那段无法用自己的话复述的文字，课后回头再看。
senses.why: Awareness becomes useful only when it is aimed at a specific task, and the first task is always the check on understanding.
senses.whyCN: 觉察只有落到具体任务上才有用，而第一项任务永远是核查理解。

senses.title: Planning a learning strategy
senses.definition: choosing in advance how to study, for example by previewing, spacing or self-testing
senses.definitionCN: 事先选定学习方式，例如预习、分散安排或自测
senses.example: Before the exam she planned which chapters needed two passes and which needed only one.
senses.exampleCN: 考试前她先规划哪些章节要过两遍、哪些只需过一遍。
senses.why: Knowing about one's own thinking allows a plan to be fitted to the material, which is why planning is counted as a metacognitive act.
senses.whyCN: 了解自己的思维，才能把计划贴合材料，因此规划被算作一种元认知行为。

senses.title: Evaluating one's own performance
senses.definition: reviewing after a task which parts went well and which strategy should change next time
senses.definitionCN: 任务结束后回顾哪些部分做得顺、下次该换哪种策略
senses.example: After the failed quiz she listed the questions she had rushed and the ones she had misread.
senses.exampleCN: 测验失利后，她列出自己抢答的题和看错题意的题。
senses.why: The same self-directed gaze can be turned backward, and this backward look is what turns an experience into a lesson.
senses.whyCN: 这种指向自身的目光也可以转向过去，而正是这回望把一次经历变成一堂课。

senses.title: Knowledge about memory and attention
senses.titleCN: 关于记忆与注意的知识
senses.definition: knowing how memory, attention and forgetting actually work, so that study can be adjusted to them
senses.definitionCN: 了解记忆、注意与遗忘的实际运作，从而据此调整学习方式
senses.example: He knew that rereading feels easy but tests poorly, so he switched to recall practice.
senses.exampleCN: 他知道重读感觉轻松却考不出效果，于是改用回忆练习。
senses.why: The compound covers more than moment-by-moment checking: it also holds the stored facts about how minds work.
senses.whyCN: 这个复合词不只覆盖当下的核查，也包含关于心智如何运作的既有知识。

senses.title: Regulating mental effort
senses.definition: deciding how much time and attention a passage or problem deserves
senses.definitionCN: 判断一段材料或一道题值得投入多少时间与注意力
senses.example: She spent four minutes on the hard item and then moved on, by design rather than by panic.
senses.exampleCN: 她在难题上花了四分钟便按计划转向下一题，而不是慌着放弃。
senses.why: Once a learner can judge difficulty, effort can be allocated instead of spilled, which is the regulating half of the term.
senses.whyCN: 学习者一旦能判断难度，心力就可以被分配而不是被洒掉，这正是这个术语中「调节」的一半。

senses.title: The research field itself
senses.definition: the academic study of how people monitor and control their own thinking
senses.definitionCN: 研究人如何监控与调控自身思维的学术领域
senses.example: The journal devoted a special issue to metacognition in early childhood.
senses.exampleCN: 这份期刊用一整期专号讨论幼儿期的元认知。
senses.why: A named mental process quickly becomes the name of the discipline that studies it, so the abstract noun also labels a field.
senses.whyCN: 一种被命名的心理过程很快会成为研究它的学科之名，因此这个抽象名词也指一个领域。

senses.title: A skill that can be taught
senses.definition: a trainable ability to reflect on and steer one's learning, promoted through prompts and modelling
senses.definitionCN: 通过提示与示范加以培养的、反思并引导自身学习的能力
senses.example: The reading programme builds metacognition by asking students to predict and then check.
senses.exampleCN: 这套阅读课程让学生先预测再核对，以此培养元认知。
senses.why: If awareness can be learned, schools can teach it directly, and the term moves from description to curriculum.
senses.whyCN: 如果觉察可以学会，学校就能直接教授，这个术语便从描述变成了课程。

intro.en: Metacognition joins a Greek prefix meaning 'about itself' to the Latin noun for knowing. The compound is a modern scientific coinage. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: metacognition 把一个表示「关于自身」的希腊语前缀接到拉丁语中表「认识」的名词上。这个复合词是现代学术造词。年代均为约数。

items.en: Greek meta meant 'after, beyond, behind'. In modern scientific compounds it shifted to 'about itself', as in a study of studies.
items.cn: 希腊语 meta 原意是「在后、超出、背后」。在现代学术复合词中它转为「关于自身」，如「对研究的研究」。

items.en: Com- 'together, thoroughly' plus gnoscere 'to come to know' produced cognoscere 'to get to know'. The deeper origin of gnoscere is not established.
items.cn: 意为「共同、彻底」的拉丁前缀加 gnoscere「逐渐知道」构成 cognoscere「认识、得知」。gnoscere 的更早来源未得到证明。

items.en: The noun cognitio named both the act of knowing and the knowledge that results from it.
items.cn: 名词 cognitio 既指认识的行为，也指由此获得的知识。

items.en: English borrowed cognition in the sixteenth century for the act of knowing; psychology later narrowed it to mental processing.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪借入 cognition 表示「认识」这一行为；心理学后来把它收窄为心理加工。

items.en: The compound is generally attributed to the developmental psychologist John Flavell in the nineteen seventies, who used it for knowledge about one's own thinking.
items.cn: 这个复合词一般认为是发展心理学家弗拉维尔在二十世纪七十年代提出的，用来指关于自身思维的知识。

items.en: Source uncertain (first printed use): the exact earliest citation is not settled, and the pre-Latin origin of the knowing root is unknown, so any older form offered for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（最早书证）：确切的最早用例尚无定论；那个表「认识」的词根在拉丁语之前的来源亦不可考，凡为其提出的更早形式均属重构形式。

note.en: Group one holds words from the same knowing family whose self-referential layer differs; group two holds near neighbours that name reflection rather than the machinery of thought.
note.cn: 第一组是同出「认识」词族、但自我指向程度不同的词；第二组是侧重反思而非思维机制本身的近义词。

entries.definition: The mental act of knowing, remembering or reasoning itself; it says nothing about noticing that one is doing these things.
entries.definitionCN: 指认识、记忆或推理的心理活动本身，并不包含「察觉自己正在做这些事」的意思。

entries.definition: Relating to mental processes in general, as in cognitive science; it is not the adjective of metacognition.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指与心理加工有关的，如认知科学；它并不是 metacognition 的形容词。

entries.definition: Built with the prefix meaning 'again' plus the knowing root, so it means identifying something as known before.
entries.definitionCN: 由表「再次」的前缀加「认识」词根构成，因此指把某物认作先前见过。

entries.definition: Built with the prefix meaning 'before', so it names claimed knowledge of future events, not awareness of one's own thinking.
entries.definitionCN: 由表「在前」的前缀构成，指对未来的所谓预知，而不是对自身思维的觉察。

entries.definition: The ongoing check on one's own performance during a task; narrower than metacognition, which also includes stored knowledge and planning.
entries.definitionCN: 指任务进行中对自身表现的持续核查，比元认知窄，后者还包含既有知识与规划。

entries.definition: The control of effort, emotion and strategy toward a goal; metacognition is the knowing side that guides this control.
entries.definitionCN: 指为达成目标而对心力、情绪与策略加以控制；元认知是指导这种控制的认识一侧。

entries.definition: Deliberate thinking about an experience after it happens; metacognition also covers what happens in the middle of a task.
entries.definitionCN: 指事后对某段经历的有意思考；元认知还覆盖任务进行中的当下。

entries.definition: Awareness of one's feelings, character and limits; metacognition is the narrower case of awareness applied to thinking.
entries.definitionCN: 指对自身情绪、性格与局限的觉察；元认知是这种觉察用在思维上的较窄情形。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the two real morphemes, the real research family and the real classroom phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：两个真实语素、真实的研究词族与真实的课堂用语。

normal.en: The first element means 'about itself', so the word literally reads thinking about thinking.
normal.cn: 第一个成分意为「关于自身」，因此这个词字面上就是「对思考的思考」。

normal.en: The second element is the Latin knowing root that also gives cognition, cognitive and recognize.
normal.cn: 第二个成分是拉丁语中表「认识」的词根，也构成 cognition、cognitive 与 recognize。

normal.en: Classroom phrases fix the term: metacognitive awareness, metacognitive strategy, metacognitive monitoring.
normal.cn: 课堂短语把这个术语固定下来：元认知意识、元认知策略、元认知监控。

normal.en: It names two halves: knowledge about thinking, and control of thinking while it happens.
normal.cn: 它包含两半：关于思维的知识，以及对进行中思维的调控。

normal.en: The noun and the adjective differ only in word class, so metacognition is the thing and metacognitive is the quality.
normal.cn: 名词与形容词只差词性：metacognition 指那种能力，metacognitive 指与之有关的性质。

abstract.en: Picture a camera able to film its own lens.
abstract.cn: 想象一台能拍摄自己镜头的相机。

abstract.en: Picture a librarian who keeps a note of how she searches, not only of what she shelves.
abstract.cn: 想象一位图书管理员，不只记录书上架的位置，还记录自己是怎么找书的。

abstract.en: Picture a ladder long enough to be leaned against itself.
abstract.cn: 想象一架长得足以靠在自己身上的梯子。

examples.en: Good readers use metacognition to notice when a sentence stops making sense.
examples.cn: 会读书的人用元认知察觉某句话何时开始读不通。

examples.en: The course teaches metacognition through short reflections after each quiz.
examples.cn: 这门课在每次小测后安排简短反思，以此教授元认知。

examples.en: Researchers measure metacognition by comparing confidence with actual accuracy.
examples.cn: 研究者通过比较信心与实际正确率来测量元认知。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「meta 在后 + cognition 认知」——站在认知背后看认知，就是元认知

root: 希腊语前缀 meta「在后、超出、关于自身」+ 拉丁 cognoscere「认识」；cognoscere 由「共同、彻底」加表「逐渐知道」的词根构成，后者更深来源不确定。英语 metacognition。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one loop: a mind turns toward its own activity. That turn is then read as bare awareness, as a check on understanding, as planning, as review, as stored knowledge, as effort control, as a research field and as a teachable skill.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一个回路展开：心智转向自己的活动。这个转向随后被读作单纯的觉察、对理解的核查、规划、回顾、既有知识、心力控制、一个研究领域，以及一种可教的能力。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a second lamp inside the head that lights the lamp already thinking.
core.cn: 核心意象：脑中亮起第二盏灯，照着自己正在思考的那盏灯。

branches.en: KNOWING ABOUT THINKING: bare awareness and stored facts about memory are the knowledge half of the term.
branches.cn: 关于思维的知识：单纯的觉察与关于记忆的既有知识，构成这个术语的知识一半。

branches.en: ONLINE CONTROL: checking comprehension and rationing effort both happen while the task is running.
branches.cn: 当下调控：核查理解与分配心力，都发生在任务进行之中。

branches.en: BEFORE AND AFTER: a plan laid in advance and a review made afterwards bracket the task.
branches.cn: 事前与事后：事先拟定的计划与事后的回顾，把任务夹在中间。

branches.en: THE FIELD: a named process turns into the discipline that studies it.
branches.cn: 学科：一种被命名的过程变成了研究它的学科。

branches.en: TEACHABLE SKILL: once awareness can be trained, it enters the curriculum.
branches.cn: 可教的能力：觉察一旦可以训练，就进入了课程。

intro.en: The word is built from a Greek prefix and a Latin root, an unusual but common pattern in scientific English, and both parts build other words.
intro.cn: 这个词由一个希腊语前缀和一个拉丁词根构成，这是学术英语中不常见却常有的组合，两部分都构成别的词。

latinIntro.en: The knowing root gives cognition, cognitive, recognize, recognition and precognition; the Greek prefix recurs in metaphysics, metabolism and metadata.
latinIntro.cn: 表「认识」的词根衍生出 cognition、cognitive、recognize、recognition 与 precognition；希腊语前缀还出现在 metaphysics、metabolism 与 metadata 中。

items.example: The prefix makes the word refer to the process it follows.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀让后面的词反过来指向那个过程本身。

items.example: The root carries the idea of getting to know rather than merely sensing.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根带着「逐渐认识」的意思，而不只是感觉到。

items.example: The noun names the process that the prefix turns back on itself.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词指那个过程，而前缀让它反过来指向自身。

items.example: The adjective describes the process but adds no self-reference.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词描述该过程，却不带自我指向。

items.example: The same root with a different prefix produces a very different verb.
items.exampleCN: 同一词根配另一个前缀，构成意思很不同的动词。

items.meaning: the act of identifying as known
items.example: The noun keeps the 'again' sense of its verb.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词保留了动词中「再次」的意思。

items.example: The compound unites the two halves into a single technical term.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词把两部分合成一个专门术语。

items.meaningCN: 与这种自我觉察有关的
items.example: The adjective is the ordinary attributive form in research writing.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词是研究写作中常用的定语形式。

items.example: The adverb describes how a learner acts rather than what they know.
items.exampleCN: 这个副词描述学习者怎样行动，而非知道什么。

definition_zh: 金属；金属材料；铁轨；重金属音乐
definition_en: a solid element or material such as iron, copper or gold, usually shiny and able to conduct heat and electricity; also a railway term and a music genre
core_image: 磁铁吊起一堆压扁的铁皮，金属在灯下泛出冷硬的光
scene: 天快黑的废料场里，吊臂上的磁铁把压扁的车壳吸到半空，铁皮互相碰撞发出脆响。A magnet lifted the crushed metal above the scrapyard.
sceneCN: 这里是「金属」（第 1 个义项：有光泽、能导电的元素）；句意为磁铁把压扁的金属吸到废料场上空。图中可辨识物件：磁铁吊臂、压扁的车壳、废料场。

pos.zh: 金属；金属材料；铁轨；重金属音乐

derivatives.zh: 由 metal 加 -ic 构成，义为「金属的；有金属光泽的」
由 metal 词干与希腊语表示「工作」的词组合，义为「冶金学」
由 metal 与 work 复合，义为「金属加工；金属制品」

senses.title: A class of shiny, workable elements
senses.definition: a chemical element such as iron, copper or gold that is usually shiny, conducts heat and electricity, and can be shaped
senses.definitionCN: 铁、铜、金一类通常有光泽、能导热导电、可加工成型的化学元素
senses.example: Iron and copper are the metals most often used in wiring and tools.
senses.exampleCN: 铁和铜是最常用于电线和工具的金属。
senses.why: Greek metallon first named what miners dug out of the earth, so the word began as the stuff of mines rather than as a chemical class; shine and weight were noticed afterwards.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 metallon 最初指矿工从地下挖出的东西，所以这个词的起点是「矿井的产出」，而不是化学分类；光泽与重量是后来才被注意到的特征。

senses.title: The material used for making things
senses.definition: the solid material obtained from such elements or their alloys, used to make tools, machines and structures
senses.definitionCN: 由这类元素或其合金得到的固态材料，用来制作工具、机器和建筑结构
senses.example: The old gate is solid metal, so it will not burn.
senses.exampleCN: 这扇旧门是实心金属做的，所以烧不起来。
senses.why: Once metallon named the mined substance, speakers could treat it as a mass that gates and engines are made of, so the word came to name raw material rather than a list of elements.
senses.whyCN: 既然 metallon 指采出的那种物质，说话人就能把它当成造门、造机器的「料」，于是词义落在原料上，而不是一份元素清单。

senses.title: Railway rails, in British usage
senses.definition: the steel rails of a railway line, usually in the plural in British railway talk
senses.definitionCN: 铁路线上的钢轨，通常用复数，是英国铁路行业的说法
senses.example: The signal failed, and the train stopped on the metals.
senses.exampleCN: 信号失灵，列车停在了铁轨上。
senses.why: Rails are the heaviest pieces of metal a passenger ever rides over, so railway talk lets the material stand in for the object made from it.
senses.whyCN: 钢轨是乘客每天压过的最重的金属件，铁路行话便用材料名代替成品，直接把它叫作 metals。

senses.title: Heavy metal music
senses.definition: a loud genre of rock music, short for heavy metal, built on distorted guitars and heavy drumming
senses.definitionCN: 一种喧闹的摇滚乐类型，是 heavy metal 的简称，以失真吉他和沉重鼓点为主
senses.example: He grew up on metal and still keeps the old records.
senses.exampleCN: 他听重金属长大，至今还留着那些旧唱片。
senses.why: The music imitates the weight of dense metal in sound, so the genre borrowed the material name to describe how it feels rather than what it is made of.
senses.whyCN: 这种音乐用声音模仿致密金属的重量感，于是曲风借用材料名来描述听感，而不是描述材质。

intro.en: Metal travelled from a Greek word for a mine through Latin and French before English used it for the shiny substance and then for a music genre.
intro.cn: metal 从一个表示「矿井」的希腊词出发，经拉丁语与法语进入英语，先指那种发亮的物质，后来又指一种音乐类型。

items.en: Metallon covered a mine, the ore dug from it and the metal smelted out of it; its deeper origin is uncertain.
items.cn: metallon 兼指矿井、采出的矿石和冶炼出的金属；更早的来源不确定。

items.en: Latin borrowed the Greek noun as metallum and kept both the mining and the metal senses.
items.cn: 拉丁语借入这个希腊名词写作 metallum，同时保留采矿与金属两层意思。

items.en: Old French passed metal to English as the name of the substance, stripped of the mine.
items.cn: 古法语把 metal 传给英语，只留下「物质」这一层，矿井的意思脱落了。

items.en: Middle English metal named the substance and also a person's temper, the two uses sharing one spelling.
items.cn: 中古英语的 metal 既指金属，也指人的性情，两种用法共用一个拼写。

items.en: Modern English split the spellings: metal kept the material, mettle kept the courage, and later the word was extended to rails and to heavy music.
items.cn: 现代英语把拼写分开：metal 保留材料义，mettle 保留勇气义；后来词义又扩展到铁轨与重金属音乐。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers relatives built on the Greek and Latin metal stem; the near-meaning group gathers other words for metals and metal-bearing rock.
note.cn: 形近组收希腊语与拉丁语 metal 词干上的同族词；近义组收其他表示金属与含金属矿石的词。

entries.definition: Made of metal, or bright and hard like it.
entries.definitionCN: 金属制的，或像金属一样光亮坚硬。

entries.definition: The science of getting metal from ore and preparing it for use.
entries.definitionCN: 从矿石中提取金属并加以处理的技术。

entries.definition: Courage and spirit; a doublet whose spelling split off from metal.
entries.definitionCN: 勇气与气概；拼写从 metal 分化出来的同源词。

entries.definition: An element whose properties sit between metals and non-metals.
entries.definitionCN: 性质介于金属与非金属之间的元素。

entries.definition: A hard, heavy metal used for tools and structures.
entries.definitionCN: 一种坚硬沉重的金属，用于工具和建筑。

entries.definition: An alloy of iron and carbon, stronger and harder than iron.
entries.definitionCN: 铁与碳的合金，比铁更硬更强。

entries.definition: A metal made by melting two or more metals together.
entries.definitionCN: 把两种或多种金属熔合而成的金属。

entries.definition: Rock or earth from which metal can be taken.
entries.definitionCN: 可以从中提取金属的矿石或泥土。

normalIntro.en: The word came out of the mine, and its family keeps splitting into material, craft, courage and sound.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词出自矿井，它的同族一路分到材料、工艺、勇气和声音。

normal.en: Greek metallon named what miners dug out, so metal began as the stuff of mines rather than a chemical category.
normal.cn: 希腊语 metallon 指矿工挖出来的东西，所以 metal 起初是矿井的产出，而不是化学分类。

normal.en: Mettle is the same word with a different spelling: the courage sense kept the old form while metal kept the material sense.
normal.cn: mettle 是同一个词的另一种拼写：勇气义保留了旧形，metal 则保留材料义。

normal.en: Metallic adds -ic, the suffix that turns a noun into the meaning relating to metal.
normal.cn: metallic 加的是 -ic，这个后缀把名词变成「与金属有关的」。

normal.en: Metallurgy joins metal to the Greek word for work, so the name says working metal rather than merely having it.
normal.cn: metallurgy 把 metal 与希腊语中表示「工作」的词结合，名字强调对金属的加工，而不是拥有金属。

normal.en: Heavy metal takes the weight of the material into music, which is why the genre is described as dense and loud.
normal.cn: heavy metal 把材料的重量带进音乐，所以这种曲风被形容为致密、喧闹。

abstract.en: Picture a mine, a furnace and a rail: one substance travelling from rock to engine.
abstract.cn: 想象矿井、熔炉和铁轨：同一种物质从岩石一路走到发动机上。

abstract.en: A word for a chemical element can also name a music genre, which shows how far a material word can drift into sound.
abstract.cn: 一个表示化学元素的词也能指一种音乐类型，可见材料词能漂移到多远的声音领域。

abstract.en: Every trusted tool is a lump of metal someone shaped, and the word still carries that dependence.
abstract.cn: 每件可信赖的工具都曾是某人塑形的一块金属，这个词仍带着这份依赖。

examples.en: The magnet lifted the crushed metal out of the pile.
examples.cn: 磁铁把压扁的金属从废料堆里吸了出来。

examples.en: Copper is a metal that carries electricity well.
examples.cn: 铜是一种导电性很好的金属。

examples.en: The band plays metal every Friday night.
examples.cn: 这支乐队每周五夜里都演奏重金属。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「卖铁」——收废品的人一喊卖铁，卖的就是一堆金属；记住 metal 是金属。

root: 希腊语 metallon（矿井、金属）经拉丁语 metallum 与古法语 metal 进入英语；同族词多与金属、冶金有关，另有拼写分化的 mettle 表示勇气。

sensesIntro.en: The core is the mined substance; from it the senses run to the material, to the rails made of it, and finally to a music named after its weight.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是矿井里采出的那种物质；义项由此走向材料、走向用材料铺成的铁轨，最后走向以它的重量命名的音乐。

core.cn: 核心意象：磁铁吊起压扁的钢壳，金属在废料场的灯下又冷又亮。

branches.cn: 废料场上磁铁吊起压扁的车壳

branches.cn: 撑起高速公路的钢梁

branches.en: a train waiting on the rails at a red signal
branches.cn: 红灯前停在铁轨上的列车

branches.en: a wall of speakers at a loud concert
branches.cn: 喧闹演出里的一整面音箱墙

branches.en: one substance running from the mine to the machine
branches.cn: 同一种物质从矿井一路走到机器上

intro.en: The word rests on a Greek mine-word and its Latin borrowing, with two English suffixes and a compound that carry the family outward.
intro.cn: 这个词立在希腊语表示矿井的词及其拉丁借词上，再由两个英语后缀和一个复合词把词族向外撑开。

sceneCN: 这里 meteorologist 指「从事气象工作的专家」（第 1 个义项：气象学家）；句意为这位气象学家预计雨带将在傍晚抵达海岸。图中可辨识物件：雷达回波、雨带、值班台、时钟。

senses.title: A weather scientist
senses.definition: a scientist whose subject is the atmosphere and its weather
senses.definitionCN: 以大气及其天气为研究对象的科学家
senses.example: The meteorologist explained why the fog formed in the valley.
senses.exampleCN: 这位气象学家解释了雾为何在山谷里形成。
senses.why: the person suffix added to the discipline names whoever practises it.
senses.whyCN: 加在学科名上的人物后缀，指从事这门学科的人。

senses.title: An operational forecaster
senses.definition: one whose daily work is to issue forecasts and warnings on a shift
senses.definitionCN: 日常工作是在轮班中发布预报与警报的人
senses.example: The meteorologist on duty updated the coastal warning.
senses.exampleCN: 值班气象员更新了沿海警报。
senses.why: the shift produces forecasts, and the title follows the shift.
senses.whyCN: 轮班产出预报，头衔就跟着轮班走。

senses.title: A research meteorologist
senses.definition: one who studies atmospheric processes rather than issuing routine forecasts
senses.definitionCN: 研究大气过程、而非发布日常预报的研究者
senses.example: A research meteorologist modelled how hail grows.
senses.exampleCN: 一位研究型气象学家模拟了冰雹如何生长。
senses.why: the same craft also asks how processes work, not only what happens next.
senses.whyCN: 同一门手艺也追问过程如何运作，而不只问接下来会怎样。

senses.title: A broadcast meteorologist
senses.definition: one who presents forecasts on radio or television and explains them to the public
senses.definitionCN: 在广播或电视上呈现预报并向公众解释的人
senses.example: The broadcast meteorologist kept the map simple.
senses.exampleCN: 这位广播气象播报员把图讲得很简单。
senses.why: a forecast needs a voice, and broadcasting created a version of the role.
senses.whyCN: 预报需要一张嘴，广播就造出这个角色的一种版本。

senses.title: An aviation meteorologist
senses.definition: one who briefs pilots on winds, icing and visibility along a route
senses.definitionCN: 向飞行员简报航线上的风、结冰与能见度的人
senses.example: An aviation meteorologist warned of icing over the pass.
senses.exampleCN: 一位航空气象员警告山口上空有结冰。
senses.why: flying needs route-specific warnings, so a specialism formed.
senses.whyCN: 飞行需要航线专项警报，于是形成一个专长。

senses.title: A military meteorologist
senses.definition: one who supplies weather support to military operations
senses.definitionCN: 为军事行动提供气象保障的人
senses.example: The military meteorologist timed the exercise around the front.
senses.exampleCN: 这位军事气象员围绕锋面安排了演习时间。
senses.why: operations need weather support, and the military kept its own specialists.
senses.whyCN: 行动需要气象保障，军队便保留自己的专家。

senses.title: A climate-adjacent specialist
senses.titleCN: 与气候研究交叉的专家
senses.definition: one whose atmospheric work overlaps with climate science and long-range outlooks
senses.definitionCN: 大气工作与气候科学及长期展望交叉的研究者
senses.example: The meteorologist worked with climatologists on the seasonal outlook.
senses.exampleCN: 这位气象学家与气候学家合作做季节展望。
senses.why: weather and climate meet at the seasonal scale, so the roles overlap.
senses.whyCN: 天气与气候在季节尺度上相遇，两个角色便重叠。

senses.title: The older sense: a sky phenomenon scholar
senses.titleCN: 旧义：研究高空现象的人
senses.definition: historical: a person who studied things high in the air, including meteors
senses.definitionCN: 历史义：研究高空之物（包括流星）的人
senses.example: An early meteorologist catalogued comets and winds alike.
senses.exampleCN: 早期这类学者把彗星与风一并记录。
senses.why: before the science split, anyone who watched the sky bore the same title.
senses.whyCN: 在学科分开之前，任何观天的人都带同一头衔。

intro.en: Meteorologist joins meteorology with the Greek-derived person suffix -ist. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: meteorologist 由 meteorology 加希腊来源的人物后缀 -ist 构成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Meteōron 'thing high up' was built on meta- 'up' and aeirein 'to lift'; its deeper origin is uncertain.
items.cn: meteōron「高处之物」由 meta-「向上」与 aeirein「举起」构成；其更深来源不确定。

items.en: The suffix for a reasoned study comes from logos 'word, reason', through Latin -logia.
items.cn: 表示有理据研究的前缀出自 logos「言词、理性」，经拉丁 -logia 传入。

items.en: Greek -istēs named a person who does something; Latin -ista and French -iste carried it into English -ist.
items.cn: 希腊 -istēs 指从事某事的人；拉丁 -ista 与法语 -iste 把它带入英语 -ist。

items.en: The title appears in the nineteenth century, as weather services begin to employ trained staff.
items.cn: 这一职称在十九世纪出现，正值气象服务开始雇用受过训练的人员。

items.en: In the twentieth century the role divided into forecast desks, research groups, aviation briefings, broadcasting and military support.
items.cn: 二十世纪这个角色分成预报台、研究组、航空简报、广播与军事保障。

items.en: First English date approximate: no exact first use of meteorologist is recorded, and it is usually dated to the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 首见年代为约数：meteorologist 的确切首见英语书证未被记录，通常定在十九世纪。

note.en: Group one holds titles that look like meteorologist but belong elsewhere; group two holds real alternatives for the same profession.
note.cn: 第一组是外形像 meteorologist、实则属于其他领域的职称；第二组才是同一职业的真正替代说法。

entries.definition: A specialist in measurement, from Greek metron; not a weather scientist.
entries.definitionCN: 研究测量的专家，词根为希腊 metron；不是气象学家。

entries.definition: A specialist in meteorites, a branch of planetary science.
entries.definitionCN: 研究陨石的专家，属行星科学分支。

entries.definition: An older word for the same profession, now rare.
entries.definitionCN: 同一职业的较旧称呼，现已罕见。

entries.definition: The adjective, not the person; it describes data and stations.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，不指人；它描述数据与台站。

entries.definition: The everyday title for the operational side of the job; a meteorologist may also do research.
entries.definitionCN: 该职业业务一侧的日常称谓；气象学家也可能做研究。

entries.definition: An informal and older word, most often for a broadcast presenter.
entries.definitionCN: 较旧的非正式说法，多指广播播报员。

entries.definition: A specialist in climates over decades, not in this week's weather.
entries.definitionCN: 研究数十年尺度气候的专家，而非本周天气。

entries.definition: A broader title covering atmospheric chemistry and physics as well as weather.
entries.definitionCN: 更宽泛的头衔，除天气外还涵盖大气化学与物理。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real word parts, real fixed phrases and real word relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实固定搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: meteorology plus -ist: the person who practises the science.
normal.cn: meteorology 加 -ist：从事这门科学的人。

normal.en: The family runs meteorology, meteorologist, meteorological, meteor.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 meteorology、meteorologist、meteorological、meteor。

normal.en: The trap is metrologist, the measurement specialist.
normal.cn: 陷阱是 metrologist，即测量专家。

normal.en: Job titles take prefixes: broadcast, aviation, research, military, agricultural.
normal.cn: 职称带前缀：广播、航空、研究、军事、农业。

normal.en: The operational product is a forecast; the research product is a paper.
normal.cn: 业务产品是预报，研究产品是论文。

abstract.cn: 想象一个人用一根手指在发亮的屏幕上描出雨带。

abstract.en: Picture a microphone in one hand and a chart in the other.
abstract.cn: 想象一手拿话筒，一手拿图表。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one practitioner through the job: the general title, then the shift forecaster, the researcher, the broadcaster, the aviation and military posts, the climate overlap and the older sky scholar.

branches.cn: 头衔：人物后缀把气象学变成一个职业。

branches.cn: 值班：预报与警报按时按点产出。

branches.en: THE RESEARCH SIDE: process studies and seasonal outlooks overlap with climate work.
branches.cn: 研究一侧：过程研究与季节展望同气候工作交叉。

branches.en: THE AUDIENCES: the public, pilots and commanders each need a different briefing.

branches.cn: 较旧的角色：同一头衔曾涵盖一切观天的人。

senses.title: The science of the atmosphere
senses.definition: the science of the atmosphere and of the weather it produces
senses.definitionCN: 研究大气及其产生的天气的科学
senses.example: Meteorology explains both a single storm and the calm after it.
senses.exampleCN: 气象学既解释一场风暴，也解释风暴之后的平静。
senses.why: the suffix for a reasoned study attached to the Greek word for things high in the air names the field.
senses.whyCN: 表示有理据研究的前缀加在希腊语「高空之物」上，就成了这门学科的名字。

senses.title: Weather observation and forecasting
senses.definition: the working practice of watching the weather and issuing forecasts
senses.definitionCN: 观察天气并发布预报的实际工作
senses.example: Meteorology in this office means three forecasts a day.
senses.exampleCN: 在这个办公室里，气象工作意味着每天三次预报。
senses.why: a science that predicts has a daily product, and the same word names the service as well as the study.
senses.whyCN: 一门会预测的科学有每日产出，于是同一个词既指研究，也指业务。

senses.title: Physical meteorology
senses.definition: the branch that studies radiation, cloud physics and the thermodynamics of the air
senses.definitionCN: 研究辐射、云物理与空气热力学的分支
senses.example: Physical meteorology measures how ice crystals grow in a cloud.
senses.exampleCN: 物理气象学测量冰晶在云中如何生长。
senses.why: physics supplies the mechanisms of cloud, radiation and heat.
senses.whyCN: 物理学提供云、辐射与热量的机制。

senses.title: Dynamic meteorology
senses.definition: the branch that applies fluid mechanics to the motions of the atmosphere
senses.definitionCN: 把流体力学用于大气运动的分支
senses.example: Dynamic meteorology treats the jet stream as a rotating fluid.
senses.exampleCN: 动力气象学把急流当作旋转流体来处理。
senses.why: fluid mechanics supplies the equations for moving air.
senses.whyCN: 流体力学提供运动空气的方程。

senses.title: Aviation and marine meteorology
senses.definition: the applied branches that serve aircraft and ships with route-specific warnings
senses.definitionCN: 为飞机与船舶提供航线专项警报的应用分支
senses.example: Aviation meteorology issues warnings for icing at altitude.
senses.exampleCN: 航空气象学发布高空结冰警报。
senses.why: users on a route need warnings tied to their path, so applied branches formed.
senses.whyCN: 航线上的使用者需要与路径相连的警报，于是形成应用分支。

senses.title: Agricultural meteorology
senses.definition: the applied branch that links weather to crops, livestock and soil
senses.definitionCN: 把天气与作物、牲畜和土壤联系起来的应用分支
senses.example: Agricultural meteorology timed the irrigation after the dry spell.
senses.exampleCN: 农业气象学在干旱期之后安排了灌溉时机。
senses.why: growers need weather turned into timing, and the branch is named for that conversion.
senses.whyCN: 种植者需要把天气变成时机，这一支就因这种转化而得名。

senses.title: The meteorological service
senses.definition: the agency or service that carries out observation and forecasting for the public
senses.definitionCN: 为公众开展观测与预报的机构或服务
senses.example: The national meteorology office upgraded its radar network.
senses.exampleCN: 国家气象部门升级了雷达网。
senses.why: institutions take the name of the science, because their whole work is that science applied.
senses.whyCN: 机构以学科之名命名，因为它们的全部工作就是这门学科的应用。

senses.title: The older sense: high phenomena
senses.definition: historical: the study of things high in the air, including shooting stars, before astronomy split off
senses.definitionCN: 历史义：在天文学分离出去之前，对高空之物（包括流星）的研究
senses.example: Early meteorology dealt with comets as well as clouds.
senses.exampleCN: 早期的气象学既处理云，也处理彗星。
senses.why: the Greek word covered everything raised above the earth, so the old sense was far wider than weather.
senses.whyCN: 希腊原词涵盖一切被举离地面的东西，因此旧义远比天气宽。

intro.en: Meteorology comes from Greek meteōrologia 'discussion of things high in the air', a compound of meteōron and the suffix for a reasoned account. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: meteorology 来自希腊 meteōrologia「对高空之物的论述」，由 meteōron 与表示有理据记述的后缀复合而成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Greek meteōron 'thing high up' is built from meta- 'beyond, up' and aeirein 'to lift, raise'. It named anything seen high in the air, including shooting stars.
items.cn: 希腊 meteōron「高处之物」由 meta-「超出、向上」与 aeirein「举起、抬高」构成，指一切在高空可见之物，包括流星。

items.en: Meteōrologia meant 'discussion of celestial and atmospheric phenomena', essentially astronomy in the ancient sense.
items.cn: meteōrologia 意为「对天象与大气现象的论述」，在古代意义上基本等同于天文学。

items.en: English meteorology appears in the early seventeenth century with that broad sense: the study of things high above the earth.
items.cn: 英语 meteorology 在十七世纪初出现，带着这一宽泛含义：研究地球上方高处之物。

items.en: As astronomy became a separate science, meteorology narrowed to the atmosphere and its weather, and by the nineteenth century it meant the science of weather.
items.cn: 随着天文学独立成科，气象学收窄到大气及其天气，到十九世纪已指天气的科学。

items.en: The field now covers observation, theory and forecasting, and divides into physical and dynamical branches.
items.cn: 这门学科如今涵盖观测、理论与预报，并分成物理与动力两大分支。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date and deeper origin): the earliest English citation is usually placed in the 1610s but is not exact, and the pre-Greek origin of aeirein is not established.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代与更深词源）：英语最早书证通常放在十七世纪一十年代，但并不确切；aeirein 在希腊语之前的来源也未得到证明。

note.en: Group one holds words that look or sound close to meteorology but belong to other roots; group two holds neighbouring sciences and services.
note.cn: 第一组是外形或读音接近气象学、却属于其他词根的词；第二组是相邻的学科与服务。

entries.definition: From Greek metron 'measure': the science of measurement. A single letter separates it from meteorology.
entries.definitionCN: 来自希腊 metron「度量」：测量科学。它与气象学只差一个字母。

entries.definition: A streak of light from a body burning in the air, or the body itself; it is one subject of meteorology, not the field.
entries.definitionCN: 物体在大气中燃烧产生的光迹，或该物体本身；它是气象学的研究对象之一，而非学科。

entries.definition: The study of meteorites, which belongs to planetary science rather than to weather.
entries.definitionCN: 研究陨石的学科，属于行星科学而非天气研究。

entries.definition: A small body in space before it enters the atmosphere; the word names an object, not a discipline.
entries.definitionCN: 进入大气之前的小天体；这个词指物体，不指学科。

entries.definition: The study of climates over decades and centuries; meteorology handles hours and days.
entries.definitionCN: 研究数十年至数百年的气候；气象学处理小时与天。

entries.definition: The broad study of the atmosphere, including chemistry and upper-air physics as well as weather.
entries.definitionCN: 对大气的广泛研究，除天气外还包括化学与高空物理。

entries.definition: The operational activity of predicting weather; it is the public face of meteorology.
entries.definitionCN: 预测天气的业务活动，是气象学面向公众的一面。

entries.definition: The physics and chemistry of the upper atmosphere; it is a narrow branch, not a synonym.
entries.definitionCN: 高层大气的物理与化学；它是狭窄分支，并非同义词。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real word parts, real fixed phrases and real word relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实固定搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Greek meteōron 'thing high up' plus the suffix for a reasoned study.
normal.cn: 希腊 meteōron「高处之物」加表示有理据研究后缀。

normal.en: The family runs meteorology, meteorologist, meteorological, meteor, meteorite.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 meteorology、meteorologist、meteorological、meteor、meteorite。

normal.en: The trap is metrology, the science of measurement, which differs by one letter.
normal.cn: 陷阱是 metrology（测量科学），只差一个字母。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark branches: synoptic, physical, dynamic, agricultural, aviation.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出分支：天气学、物理、动力、农业、航空。

normal.en: The old sense covered shooting stars, which is why meteor is a sky object, not a weather word.
normal.cn: 旧义涵盖流星，所以 meteor 是天空物体，而非天气词。

abstract.en: Picture three maps laid on one desk: cloud, radar and a station table.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上叠着三张图：云图、雷达图与台站表。

abstract.en: Picture a single arrow drawn from a cloud to a coastline.
abstract.cn: 想象从云朵画向海岸的一条箭头。

abstract.en: Picture an old astronomer and a modern forecaster looking at the same sky.
abstract.cn: 想象古代天文学家与现代预报员望着同一片天。

examples.en: Meteorology turned the storm into a track on a map.
examples.cn: 气象学把这场风暴变成地图上的一条路径。

examples.en: She studied meteorology before joining the forecast desk.
examples.cn: 她在进入预报台之前学的是气象学。

examples.en: The society publishes research in dynamic meteorology.
examples.cn: 该学会发表动力气象学的研究。

dict_mnemonic.text: meteor 是「高空之物」，加上 -logy（学科）：研究高空之物的学问 → 气象学；注意别和测量科学 metrology 混淆

root: 希腊 meteōron「高处之物」（meta-「超出」+ aeirein「举起」）+ 希腊 -logia「研究」→ meteorology；aeirein 更深来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one science from its old breadth to its modern branches: the field, its forecast work, its physical and dynamical halves, its aviation and farm applications, its public agency, and finally the older study of everything high in the air.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一门学科从旧日的宽广走向现代的分支：学科本身、预报业务、物理与动力两半、航空与农业应用、面向公众的机构，最后是旧日对一切高空之物的研究。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cloud, a radar echo and a station table laid on the same desk.
core.cn: 核心意象：云图、雷达回波与台站表铺在同一张桌上。

branches.en: FROM HIGH THINGS TO WEATHER: the old wide sense and the modern field share the same name.
branches.cn: 从高空之物到天气：旧日宽泛义与现代学科共用同一个名字。

branches.en: THE DAILY PRODUCT AND THE AGENCY: a predicting science becomes a service and an office.
branches.cn: 每日产出与机构：一门会预测的科学变成了服务与部门。

branches.en: PHYSICS: radiation and cloud physics explain how the air makes its weather.
branches.cn: 物理：辐射与云物理说明空气如何造出天气。

branches.en: DYNAMICS: fluid mechanics explains how the air moves.
branches.cn: 动力：流体力学说明空气如何运动。

branches.en: TWO USERS: aircraft need warnings, farms need timing.
branches.cn: 两类使用者：飞机要警报，农田要时机。

intro.en: Meteorology is a Greek compound whose pieces also build meteor, meteorite and the names of many sciences.
intro.cn: meteorology 是一个希腊复合词，其构件还构成 meteor、meteorite 以及许多学科名。

latinIntro.en: Greek meteōron and -logia passed into modern Latin as meteorologia, and the same pieces appear in Latinized scientific names.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊 meteōron 与 -logia 作为 meteorologia 进入现代拉丁语，同样的构件也出现在拉丁化的科学名称中。

items.meaning: anything raised high in the air
items.meaningCN: 高空中被举起的任何东西
items.example: The word first named the sky itself.
items.exampleCN: 这个词最初指的就是天空。

items.example: The prefix lifts the eye above the ground.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把目光抬到地面之上。

items.example: The verb supplies the idea of being raised.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供「被举高」的意思。

items.meaning: a sky phenomenon; a shooting star
items.example: A meteor crossed the northern sky.
items.exampleCN: 一颗流星划过北方的天空。

items.example: A meteorologist read the radar loop.
items.exampleCN: 一位气象学家解读雷达回波动画。

items.example: The meteorological station logged the wind.
A meteoroid becomes a meteor when it burns.
items.exampleCN: 流星体燃烧时就成了流星。

latinEntries.meaning: the study of high phenomena; meteorology
latinEntries.meaningCN: 高空现象的研究；气象学

latinEntries.structure: meteorum, meteori (n., second declension, from Greek)
latinEntries.meaning: a thing high in the air

definition_zh: 甲烷；最简单的烷烃，一个碳原子与四个氢原子结合的气体
definition_en: the simplest hydrocarbon, a colourless gas of one carbon atom bonded to four hydrogen atoms
core_image: 燃气灶上稳定的蓝色火焰，灶台旁放着一只检测管
scene: 厨房里，燃气灶的蓝色火焰稳定地燃烧，工程师蹲下检查管道接口。The blue flame on the stove is methane burning with plenty of oxygen.
sceneCN: 这里指作为燃气主要成分的甲烷（第 2 个义项：天然气的主体成分）；句意为灶上的蓝色火焰就是甲烷在氧气充足时燃烧。图中可辨识物件：燃气灶、蓝色火焰、管道接口、检测管。

pos.zh: 名词：不可数，指这种气体或其在混合物中的成分

derivatives.zh: 由本词词干加表示「基团」的成分构成，义为「甲基」
由「甲基」加表示「醇」的成分构成，义为「甲醇」
本词与表示「水合物」的词构成的复合术语，义为「甲烷水合物」
由本词加表示「产生者」的成分构成，义为「产甲烷菌」
由本词加表示「生成」的成分构成，义为「产甲烷过程」
由本词加表示「以……为食」的成分构成，义为「食甲烷的」

senses.title: The chemical compound
senses.definition: the simplest alkane, a colourless and odourless gas with one carbon and four hydrogen atoms
senses.definitionCN: 最简单的烷烃，一个碳原子与四个氢原子结合的无色无味气体
senses.example: Methane is the simplest hydrocarbon, one carbon atom bonded to four hydrogen atoms.
senses.exampleCN: 甲烷是最简单的烃，一个碳原子与四个氢原子相连。
senses.why: Chemistry needed a name for the first member of the alkane series, and every later member is built by adding carbon units.
senses.whyCN: 化学需要为烷烃系列的第一个成员命名，此后每个成员都以增加碳单位的方式构造。

senses.title: The main part of natural gas
senses.definition: the dominant component of the gas extracted from wells and burned for heat and power
senses.definitionCN: 从井中采出、用于取暖与发电的气体的主体成分
senses.example: Natural gas is mostly methane, with small amounts of heavier gases.
senses.exampleCN: 天然气主要是甲烷，另含少量较重的气体。
senses.why: The fuel people call gas is chemically almost one substance, which is why the two names are often used interchangeably.
senses.whyCN: 人们称作「燃气」的燃料在化学上几乎是单一物质，因此两个名称常被混用。

senses.title: Livestock and agricultural emissions
senses.definition: methane produced by ruminant digestion and by flooded rice fields
senses.definitionCN: 反刍动物消化与淹水稻田所产生的甲烷
senses.example: Cattle and rice paddies are large sources of methane.
senses.exampleCN: 牛群与稻田是甲烷的重要来源。
senses.why: Microbes in oxygen-free stomachs and mud make the gas, so agriculture becomes a chemical source.
senses.whyCN: 无氧的胃与泥中的微生物制造了这种气体，农业因此成为化学来源。

senses.title: Landfill gas and biogas
senses.definition: the gas released by decomposing waste or produced in a digester, often captured as fuel
senses.definitionCN: 垃圾分解释放或在消化器中产生、常被收集作燃料的气体
senses.example: Landfill methane can be captured and burned for power.
senses.exampleCN: 填埋场产生的甲烷可以被收集并燃烧发电。
senses.why: Waste buried without air is digested the same way a stomach digests, and the product can be put to use.
senses.whyCN: 无氧埋藏的垃圾像胃一样被消化，产物还可以被利用。

senses.title: A greenhouse gas
senses.definition: a gas that absorbs infrared radiation and warms the atmosphere, molecule for molecule far stronger than carbon dioxide over short spans
senses.definitionCN: 吸收红外辐射并使大气变暖的气体，短期内逐分子远强于二氧化碳
senses.example: Methane traps far more heat per molecule than carbon dioxide over a short period.
senses.exampleCN: 短期内甲烷每个分子截留的热量远多于二氧化碳。
senses.why: Its molecular bonds match infrared wavelengths, which is exactly what makes it a warming agent.
senses.whyCN: 它的分子键振动与红外波段相匹配，这正是它成为升温因素的原因。

senses.title: Methane hydrate
senses.definition: an ice-like solid in which methane sits inside cages of water molecules, found in deep sediments
senses.definitionCN: 甲烷被水分子笼状结构包裹的冰状固体，见于深海沉积层
senses.example: Methane hydrate is an ice-like solid found in deep sea sediments.
senses.exampleCN: 甲烷水合物是一种见于深海沉积层的冰状固体。
senses.why: Cold and pressure let water build cages around the gas, storing energy in a form that looks like ice.
senses.whyCN: 低温与高压让水在气体周围搭起笼子，把能量储存在看起来像冰的形态里。

senses.title: Methane in the carbon cycle
senses.definition: the short-lived but intense step in which carbon passes through a one-carbon gas before returning to carbon dioxide
senses.definitionCN: 碳以单碳气体形态经过的短暂而强烈的环节，随后返回二氧化碳
senses.example: Methane has a short lifetime in the air, but it is a potent warming agent.
senses.exampleCN: 甲烷在大气中的寿命很短，却是强效的升温因素。
senses.why: A gas that leaves the air quickly can still do damage quickly, so lifetime and potency must be read together.
senses.whyCN: 离开大气很快的气体也能很快造成影响，因此寿命与强度必须一起看。

senses.title: Methane on other worlds
senses.definition: the same molecule detected in the atmospheres and surfaces of other planets and moons
senses.definitionCN: 在其他行星与卫星的大气或表面探测到的同一分子
senses.example: Titan's atmosphere is rich in methane, giving it an orange haze.
senses.exampleCN: 土卫六的大气富含甲烷，因此呈现橙色雾霭。
senses.why: The molecule is common enough in the solar system that it becomes a marker of chemistry elsewhere.
senses.whyCN: 这种分子在太阳系中足够常见，因而成为其他地方化学活动的标记。

senses.title: Mine gas
senses.definition: the methane that accumulates in coal mines and must be drained or ventilated to prevent explosion
senses.definitionCN: 积聚在煤矿中、必须抽排或通风以防爆炸的甲烷
senses.example: Mine methane has to be ventilated before it can explode.
senses.exampleCN: 矿井甲烷必须先通风排出，否则就会爆炸。
senses.why: A gas that is harmless in a kitchen becomes a hazard when it collects in a confined working space.
senses.whyCN: 在厨房里无害的气体，一旦在封闭的工作空间聚集就成了危险。

intro.en: The name was coined in the nineteenth century from the Greek words for wine and wood, by way of the radical methyl. The coinage is documented; the exact year it was proposed is usually given as approximate.
intro.cn: 这个名称于十九世纪由表示「酒」与「木」的希腊词经「甲基」这一基团名构造而成。造词过程有据，提出的确切年份通常只给约数。

items.en: Methy meant wine, and the early chemists linked the radical to alcohol.
items.cn: 这个词表示酒，早期化学家因此把这个基团与酒精联系起来。

items.en: Hyle meant wood or matter, the second half of the older radical name.
items.cn: 这个词表示木或物质，是较早基团名的后半部分。

items.en: French chemists formed a name for the radical from those two Greek elements.
items.cn: 法国化学家由这两个希腊成分构造出该基团的名称。

items.en: The shorter radical name methyl then served as the base for the gas.
items.cn: 较短的基团名「甲基」随后成为这种气体的构词基础。

items.en: A suffix was chosen to mark hydrocarbons with only single bonds.
items.cn: 人们选定一个词尾来标记只含单键的烃。

items.en: Methyl plus that suffix gave methane, proposed in the eighteen sixties and quickly adopted.
items.cn: 「甲基」加上该词尾得到甲烷，于十九世纪六十年代提出并被迅速采用。

note.en: The first group shares the methyl stem or the alkane suffix; the second group names other gases of the same family or of the carbon cycle.
note.cn: 第一组共享「甲基」词干或烷烃词尾；第二组指同族或碳循环中的其他气体。

entries.definition: The chemical group of one carbon and three hydrogens.
entries.definitionCN: 一个碳与三个氢组成的化学基团。

entries.definition: The simplest alcohol, one carbon with an attached hydroxyl group.
entries.definitionCN: 最简单的醇，一个碳上连有羟基。

entries.definition: The older radical name from which methyl was shortened.
entries.definitionCN: 较早的基团名，甲基由其缩短而来。

entries.definition: The two-carbon member of the same alkane series.
entries.definitionCN: 同一烷烃系列中的二碳成员。

entries.definition: A microbe that produces methane.
entries.definitionCN: 产生甲烷的微生物。

entries.definition: The fuel mixture that is mostly methane.
entries.definitionCN: 以甲烷为主的燃料混合物。

entries.definition: Gas produced by decomposing organic matter.
entries.definitionCN: 有机物分解产生的气体。

entries.definition: The two-oxygen gas that methane becomes when it burns or breaks down.
entries.definitionCN: 甲烷燃烧或分解后生成的含两个氧的气体。

entries.definition: Any gas that traps heat in the atmosphere.
entries.definitionCN: 任何在大气中截留热量的气体。

entries.definition: An old name for methane bubbling out of wetlands.
entries.definitionCN: 对湿地冒出的甲烷的旧称。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations follow the gas from a single molecule to the stove, the farm, the landfill and the mine; abstract ones treat it as a short-lived but strong lever on the climate.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想沿着气体从单个分子到灶台、农场、填埋场与矿井展开；抽象联想把它看作对气候短暂却有力的杠杆。

normal.en: One carbon holding four hydrogens: that is the whole molecule.
normal.cn: 一个碳抱四个氢，整个分子就是这样。

normal.en: A kitchen flame is methane meeting enough oxygen.
normal.cn: 厨房的火焰就是甲烷遇到充足的氧气。

normal.en: Cows and flooded fields make it without any flame at all.
normal.cn: 牛与淹水的田地完全不靠火焰也能制造它。

normal.en: Buried waste releases it, and pipelines can collect it.
normal.cn: 埋藏的垃圾会释放它，管道可以把它收集起来。

normal.en: In a mine the same gas must be drained before it gathers.
normal.cn: 在矿井里，同样的气体必须在其聚集前被抽走。

abstract.en: Methane is a short-lived gas with a loud voice.
abstract.cn: 甲烷是一种寿命短、嗓门大的气体。

abstract.en: Because it leaves quickly, its damage is concentrated in time.
abstract.cn: 因为它离开得快，它的影响在时间上被集中。

abstract.en: A molecule that appears in kitchens, swamps and distant moons is the same molecule everywhere.
abstract.cn: 出现在厨房、沼泽与遥远卫星上的分子，在任何地方都是同一个分子。

examples.en: The lab measured methane in air samples from the landfill.
examples.cn: 实验室测量了填埋场空气样本中的甲烷。

examples.en: Methane is a far more potent warming gas than carbon dioxide.
examples.cn: 甲烷是比二氧化碳强得多的升温气体。

examples.en: Drilling released methane that had been trapped in the sediment.
examples.cn: 钻探释放了原本封存在沉积物中的甲烷。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「米散」——一个碳四个氢的气体散在空气里：甲烷

root: 由十九世纪化学命名体系构造：希腊语 methy「酒」与 hyle「木、物质」先构成基团名 methyl，再加表示单键烃的词尾构成 methane。「甲烷」这一中文名取「甲」为第一、首位的含义。造词过程清楚，确切提出年份为约数。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one molecule from the flask to the stove, the herd, the landfill, the atmosphere, the deep sea, other worlds and the mine.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项跟踪同一个分子，从烧瓶走到灶台、畜群、填埋场、大气、深海、其他天体与矿井。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a steady blue flame on a stove.
core.cn: 核心意象：灶台上一簇稳定的蓝色火焰。

branches.en: THE CORE: one carbon with four hydrogens, and the fuel that is mostly this gas.
branches.cn: 核心：一个碳配四个氢，以及以它为绝对主体的燃料。

branches.en: THE PRODUCERS: animals and flooded fields, then buried waste and digesters.
branches.cn: 产生者：牲畜与淹水田地，然后是埋藏垃圾与消化器。

branches.en: THE CLIMATE ROLE: a strong absorber with a short stay in the air.
branches.cn: 气候角色：强吸收者，但在空气中停留短暂。

branches.en: THE DEEP STORE: gas held in icy cages under the sea floor.
branches.cn: 深海储存：被封在海底冰笼中的气体。

branches.en: THE ELSEWHERE AND THE DANGER: distant atmospheres and the confined space of a mine.
branches.cn: 他处与危险：遥远天体的大气，以及矿井的封闭空间。

intro.en: Two Greek nouns were fused into a chemical radical name, and a suffix for single bonds completed the gas.
intro.cn: 两个希腊名词被融合成一个化学基团名，再由一个表示单键的词尾完成这种气体的命名。

latinIntro.en: Greek supplies the words for wine and wood; the radical name came through French, and the gas name was coined in German and English chemistry. No Latin noun underlies the word, so the Latin entry list is left empty.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语提供了表示「酒」与「木」的词；基团名经法语传来，气体名则由德国与英国化学界构造。词背后没有拉丁名词，因此拉丁词条列表留空。

items.example: The first element tied the radical to alcohol.
items.exampleCN: 第一个成分把这个基团与酒精联系起来。

items.example: The second element named the material side of the radical.
items.exampleCN: 第二个成分命名该基团的物质一面。

items.example: It became the base of the gas name.
items.exampleCN: 它成为气体名称的基础。

items.example: It marked the older radical rather than the final gas.
